profile.address: Leesburg, VA (True North Data campus, off Thunderball Drive)
profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record is labeled TikTok Data Center and sits within a data center campus in Leesburg, Virginia, that Loudoun County own zoning and permitting records identify by the project name True North Data. That project name traces to Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, which rezoned roughly 105 acres to Planned Development-Office Park specifically to allow data center uses and was approved January 18, 2018, on a parcel, county PIN 194103673000, recorded under a condominium-regime plat named True North Land Condo, a structure commonly used to subdivide one large hyperscale campus into separately titled buildings. Direct review of this record own OpenStreetMap edit history, however, shows that the TikTok Data Center name was not present when the building was first mapped in May 2025 under operator True North Data Solutions. It was added six months later, in a November 2025 edit by the same single contributor, whose changeset comment reads only Changed name and whose source field cites nothing more than local knowledge, with no linked news article, corporate filing, or permit record supporting the change. No trade press coverage, Loudoun County zoning-case record, or corporate filing naming TikTok or its parent company ByteDance in connection with this address or the broader True North Data project could be located during this research, given that general web search was unavailable this session, so given the significance of a claim connecting a foreign-owned social media company to a specific piece of American data center infrastructure, this record does not assert TikTok occupancy as fact. It should be read as an unconfirmed, single-source claim pending independent corroboration, presented alongside the same well-documented county zoning and permitting history that applies to every building on this campus, none of which gives a total megawatt capacity, building count, or square footage for the completed campus.
profile.research_note: IMPORTANT: TikTok/ByteDance connection is explicitly UNCONFIRMED. OSM edit history shows the building was created May 2025 as True North Data Solutions and renamed TikTok Data Center in a Nov 2025 edit by the same single contributor citing only local knowledge, no citation, no linked source. County-level True North Data project documentation (ZMAP-2017-0003 etc) is the same well-sourced material used across this cluster and is independently solid regardless of the tenant-name question.

reading.body:
No published capacity figure exists for this campus, so its scale cannot be assessed against Virginia's mapped facilities. The zoning record confirms that roughly 105 acres in Loudoun County were rezoned in January 2018 under case ZMAP-2017-0003 specifically to permit data center uses, and that a True North Data Solutions campus occupies this site under a condominium structure typical of hyperscale builds. Without a megawatt specification or building count, the physical footprint alone does not indicate whether this is a single building, a multi-building campus, or how many accelerators it could host.

An OpenStreetMap entry labels this facility as a TikTok Data Center, but that name was added in November 2025 by a single contributor citing only local knowledge, with no linked government permit, corporate filing, or trade press report to corroborate the claim. No independent source naming TikTok or its parent ByteDance in connection with this address or the True North Data project was found. The claim should be treated as unconfirmed pending corroboration from an official record or public statement.

Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities, but only 23 publish megawatt capacity, totaling 1,375 MW. This campus ranks 24th among published-capacity facilities in the state, a rank derived from zero published megawatts and therefore meaningless. Until the operator publishes capacity, building count, power feed size, or interconnection plans, this site cannot be weighed against the state's AI infrastructure inventory.
